:::{#exm-product-sigma-algebra}
#### Product $\sigma$-algebras

- Give the die rolls $D$ the $\sigma$-algebra $\salg$ of all its subsets.
  Each single pair $\set{(a, b)} = \set{a} \times \set{b}$ in $D \times D$
  is a measurable rectangle.
  Every subset of $D \times D$ is a union of finitely many single pairs,
  and $\salg \otimes \salg$ contains finite unions of its sets
  (@thm-sigma-algebra-closure), as well as $\emptyset$,
  so $\salg \otimes \salg$ is the collection of all subsets of $D \times D$.
- The rectangle $[0, 2] \times [0, 3]$
  is a measurable rectangle for the Borel $\sigma$-algebras,
  so it is in $\borel \otimes \borel$.

:::
